caption:
Dario Amodei, Anthropic CEO:

“I think it will actually be possible to cure most human disease in ~5–10 years.”

Amodei says Anthropic is ramping up its efforts in biology and medicine, with “some early glimmers in the coming months” and “incredible results in the coming years.”

He says he feels a personal urgency around medical progress:

“I lost my father to Hepatitis C only a few years before the development of direct-acting antivirals (sofosbuvir), which cure 95% of patients and probably would have cured him.”

And when Anthropic has actually accomplished something real:

“the whole world will hear about it, as loudly as possible.”
